title: EU-Startups: Structured AI Raises Pre-Seed to Automate Design Engineering
summary: As covered by EU-Startups, Structured AI raised pre-seed funding to build AI agents that automate repetitive design engineering workflows and reduce construction rework.
body_markdown:
# EU-Startups: Structured AI Raises Pre-Seed to Automate Design Engineering


Press


2025-07-30


EU-Startups covered our pre-seed raise, closed in under a week, backed by Zero Prime Ventures, Airtree Ventures, and the Oxford Seed Fund. Raymond Zhao, Brandon Abreu Smith, and Isabel Greenslade, all University of Oxford graduates, founded Structured AI to automate the manual drawing review and QA/QC workflows that consume over a third of engineering hours on every construction project.


[Try Automated Drawing Review](https://getstructured.ai/contact/)
